title: Consciousness runs algorithms in space within the field

statements.text: An electromagnetic field can compute, as a logic gate distributed over the space of overlapping fields, and field-implemented algorithms in the brain are the physical substrate of conscious thoughts. Such an algorithm works only when its nodes fire synchronously.

sources.quote: Field-implemented algorithms such as these, but in the brain, are, I argue, the physical substrate of conscious thoughts.
an algorithm in space can function only when its computational nodes fire synchronously
